reasoning_evidence: IA First Amendment (signed 2022-11-16) Exhibit B sets Commercial Operation date 2026-05-30 -- exact match to queue's reported COD claim; this is the contractually scheduled date, not evidence it was met
Original IA (signed 2022-04-27) Exhibit B set Commercial Operation 2024-12-24 -- one prior slip of ~17 months, made pre-construction
Both IA exhibits state schedule is contractually DEPENDENT on the separate Shaula I Energy Project (22INR0251) -- delays to Shaula I extend Shaula II 1:1
Reported COD 2026-05-30 has ALREADY PASSED (today 2026-07-21) with zero visible construction activity in current satellite imagery -- the contractual date has been missed

No Lightsource bp / BP financing, groundbreaking, or construction announcement exists for Shaula I or II anywhere in press/newsroom search (contrast: Starr Solar and Second Division Solar, and earlier Elm Branch/Briar Creek, all got explicit BP/Lightsource press releases at financial close)

BP took full ownership of Lightsource bp Oct 2024, then announced Feb 2025 a renewables-capex cut from ~$5B/yr to $1.5-2B/yr under shareholder pressure -- corporate headwind coinciding with when Shaula II needed construction NTP + security escalation

Ch313 value-limitation agreement WAS executed (Yoakum ISD, 2022-11-17) and financial security IS posted per the IA -- these show the project cleared early legal/contractual gates, but do not show construction commitment: FIS never completed after ~4 years per REFRESH_DIRECTIVE despite signed IA, and EIA-860M has zero record of this project ever existing
